newsitem.title: USA: Toy Biz tries to prevent Marvel meddling.
newsitem.headline: Toy Biz tries to prevent Marvel meddling.

text.p: Toy Biz Inc said Tuesday it had filed an adversary proceeding in bankruptcy court to prevent Marvel Entertainment Group Inc from "interfering" with its management.
The company also said it had appointed four directors to its board.

Toy Biz said it filed a proceeding for declaratory and injunctive relief "to prevent any interference by Marvel creditors with the management of Toy Biz by its incumbent board of directors and its duly appointed officers".
On Monday, Marvel said it intended to place a new majority on the company's board, adding that it was prepared to bring the matter to court.

Toy Biz has denied Marvel's claim that it still controled 70 percent of the company. It said Marvel's super-voting rights associated with the Toy Biz shares it holds were canceled when a group of bondholders took control of Marvel last week.
It said Marvel's control of the company had been reduced to 27 percent.

Toy Biz also said it had named four directors to fill vacancies on its board caused by the June 20 resignations of five directors who were officers of either Marvel or MacAndrews & Forbes Holdings Inc.
